standard_prerequisites.name: q-integer arithmetic in the standing field
standard_prerequisites.statement: The field F and the nonzero q in F with q^4 not 1 are as fixed at source lines 240-244, and the q-integer [n]_q = (q^n - q^-n)/(q - q^-1) satisfies [3]_q = 0 exactly when q^6 = 1.
standard_prerequisites.use: Splits the two directions of the counted claim at source lines 2210-2211 and 2324-2326.

standard_prerequisites.name: Free product of two cyclic groups of order three
standard_prerequisites.statement: For G = H * K with H and K cyclic of order three and generators h and k, every element of G has a unique reduced alternating normal form, and the elements of G form a basis of the group algebra F G.
standard_prerequisites.use: Used at source lines 2343-2357 to define the module and at 2382-2392 to certify that the displayed element of F G is nonzero.

standard_prerequisites.name: Associative expansion identities
standard_prerequisites.statement: The commutator identity of lem:gen(i)-(ii) is an expansion identity valid in any associative algebra, and a relation of the form X^3 Y - Y X^3 = c (X Y - Y X) makes the element X^3 - c X commute with Y, hence central in O.
standard_prerequisites.use: Used at source lines 2330-2338 for the degenerate case q^6 = 1.

core_obligations: Derive the expansion identity of lem:gen(ii) and use it, with [3]_q nonzero, to write [xi_1, xi_2] times [3]_q as the sum of the two fivefold q-brackets, then reduce each fivefold bracket to (q^2 - q^-2)^4 [X,Y] or its negative and conclude commutativity when q^6 is not 1.
When q^6 = 1, derive the simplified relations X^3 Y - Y X^3 = 3 (X Y - Y X) and Y^3 X - X Y^3 = 3 (Y X - X Y), and the centrality of X^3 - 3X and of Y^3 - 3Y in O.

Construct the O-module structure on the group algebra F G of the free product of two cyclic groups of order three by the case-table action of X and Y, and verify that this action satisfies the two defining tridiagonal relations with X^3 = 3X and Y^3 = 3Y on the basis G.
Evaluate [xi_1, xi_2] at the vector 1 of F G and prove that the resulting twelve-term group-algebra element is nonzero in the reduced normal form, so that xi_1 and xi_2 do not commute when q^6 = 1.

proof_roadmap.step: General expansion identity and its normalized nested-commutator form.

spans.label: first half of the proof of lem:RS2

proof_roadmap.step: Case q^6 not 1: [3]_q is nonzero, [xi_1, xi_2] reduces to two fivefold brackets and vanishes.

spans.label: second half of the proof of lem:RS2

proof_roadmap.step: Case q^6 = 1: simplified relations, centrality of X^3 - 3X and Y^3 - 3Y, and the case-table action on F G.
Evaluate [xi_1, xi_2] at 1 and prove the result nonzero, so the elements do not commute.

difficulty_reason: The counted statement concerns the two explicit elements xi_1 = XY - YX and xi_2 = X^2Y^2 - Y^2X^2 + (q^2 + q^-2)(YXYX - XYXY) of the q-Onsager algebra O defined by the two tridiagonal relations (source lines 2083-2115). Its first direction needs the normalized nested-commutator identity of lem:gen(ii) together with a fivefold q-bracket computation at [3]_q nonzero (source lines 2212-2316). Its second direction at q^6 = 1 cannot be obtained by rewriting the defining relations: the author must construct an explicit module structure on the group algebra of the free product of two cyclic groups of order three with a four-case action table (source lines 2343-2373) and then prove a specific twelve-term group-algebra element nonzero in the free-product normal form (source lines 2374-2397).

compared.statement: The center of the universal Askey-Wilson algebra over a field is freely spanned by monomials in its Casimir and three specified central generators when the nonzero deformation parameter is not a root of unity.
compared.difference: A basis statement about the center of Delta; it never mentions the q-Onsager algebra O or the elements xi_1, xi_2 and does not decide when they commute.

compared.statement: Faithfulness of the modular-group action on the universal Askey-Wilson algebra (source label thm:faith).

compared.statement: The explicit universal Askey-Wilson homomorphism into U_q(sl_2) tensor a three-variable Laurent polynomial algebra is injective for nonzero q with q^4 not 1.
compared.difference: Another paper and another algebra homomorphism; no q-Onsager commutativity statement.
